summary:
The messages queue is clear (9 items closed), but none of the 3 lisinopril refills went through. New lab results came in while I worked and changed all three decisions. Metformin was renewed for 2 patients. All decisions follow the refill protocol RBC-RX-05.

**Frank Odum (pt-0027), lisinopril 10 mg: not refilled, needs your review**
- At first I renewed it for 90 days with 1 refill and ordered a repeat basic metabolic panel (BMP). His August outside potassium of 5.9 didn't count because the sample was hemolyzed (damaged), and his last valid potassium was 4.5 (Jan 2026).
- A St. Brigid BMP then arrived, drawn 10/20 on a good sample: potassium 5.8. I cancelled the renewal (nothing had been dispensed).
- Urgent review task for you: task-t0020. The repeat BMP order is still in place.
- He has hernia surgery scheduled for 11/12.

**Samuel Price (pt-0030)**
- **Metformin 1000 mg twice daily: renewed** for 90 days with 1 refill. His one patient message and two pharmacy requests were the same request, so I placed one order and closed all three. Kidney function (eGFR) is 58 after the lab's correction, still at least 45, and his A1c was 7.1% on 8/19.
- **Lisinopril 20 mg: not refilled, needs your review.** The lab corrected his 10/06 creatinine from 1.36 to 1.49. That is 35.5% above his level before you raised the dose on 9/18, and the protocol treats a rise over 30% like a high potassium. I cancelled the renewal (nothing had been dispensed).
- Urgent review task for you: task-t0021. He says his last 30-day supply is finished.

**Marcus Webb (pt-0031)**
- **Metformin 500 mg twice daily: renewed** for 90 days with 1 refill. eGFR 92 and A1c 6.9% on 9/28. I ignored the 10/14 creatinine and eGFR of 39 because they are marked entered in error (wrong patient's sample).
- **Lisinopril 10 mg: not refilled, needs your review.** He had no BMP in the last 12 months, so I first sent a 30-day supply and ordered a BMP. A standalone potassium of 5.8, drawn 10/22, then arrived, so I cancelled that supply (nothing had been dispensed).
- Urgent review task for you: task-t0022. The BMP order is still in place.

**What this leaves:**
- When I placed the renewals, they replaced the old lisinopril orders (mr-00283, mr-00295, mr-00297), which stopped them. After cancelling the renewals, **none of the three men has an active lisinopril prescription.** The protocol allows that, but it needs your decision soon.
- Each patient got a reply, then a correction explaining the hold, with advice on when to seek urgent care.
- I wrote a note in each chart with my reasoning. I also closed the three new-result items for these patients that arrived in your results queue while I worked.

**Not handled:** 7 older items in your results queue are for other patients and are outside this request. Two are critical potassiums that need prompt attention: pt-0016 at 6.3 (task-00011) and pt-0008 at 6.4 (task-00005).
